artworks.title: Lola de Valence
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a woman standing with one leg slightly in front of the other. She appears relaxed and poised, with her head slightly tilted, gazing directly at the viewer. The woman has delicate facial features, dark hair styled up with a few locks framing her face, and a thin, light shawl draped over her head and shoulders. She wears an elegant dress with a dark skirt and light bodice adorned with lace or decorative elements. The woman has a bracelet on her wrist and holds a folded fan in one hand. The background is a simple, textured space. The overall tone of the image is monochromatic, using warm sepia tones.

artworks.title: Edgar Poe
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a man in an oval frame. He is facing forward and has distinctively etched features, including a mustache and pointed sideburns. The man is wearing a suit with a high-collared shirt and a dark tie. The oval frame is topped with a decorative bow. The background is plain, with a textured surface.

artworks.title: Dead Toreador (Torero mort)
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying down on their back with closed eyes and dark hair. They are wearing dark clothing and holding a long, thin object in one hand. The background is a simple, monochromatic surface. The artwork is signed "Manet" in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Au Paradis (In the Balcony)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an audience at an event. The image is rendered in a monochromatic color scheme, featuring high-contrast black ink on a cream-colored background. The scene includes a group of individuals, appearing to be seated in a public space. Their faces are stylized with simplistic, expressive features, and there is a notable use of shadow and line to convey texture and depth. The drawing captures a sense of curiosity and anticipation, with the figures leaning slightly forward. The scene's background is abstract, which frames the figures and brings focus to their expressions. The artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner of the image. The overall style of the drawing suggests an influence from early 20th-century illustration or printmaking.

artworks.title: A mapp of ye improved part of Pensilvania in America, divided into countyes, townships and lotts
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an antique map illustrating a part of Pennsylvania in early America. The map shows a region divided into counties, townships, and lots, with a layout of the city of Philadelphia in an inset at the top. This historical map features ornate scrollwork, detailed townships, rivers, and coastlines of Pennsylvania and parts of West New Jersey. Labels and annotations throughout the map specify various estates and landowners in a parcel-based colonial layout. The map includes additional tables and a legend detailing settlement names and their corresponding areas. Decorative elements such as a compass rose and a heraldic crest add an elegant touch typical of cartographic works from the period.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Julius Caesar: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bust and text. At the center-top is a detailed drawing of a bust depicting a classical male head with stylized hair. Below the bust, there is a coat of arms or shield emblem added to the composition. The artwork features a block of text in Latin, arranged in neat lines and utilizing various fonts. The paper has an aged appearance, with a color suggesting antiquity, presenting the text in a formal manner. The artwork likely served a commemorative or honorary purpose, as indicated by its formal presentation and the ancient Roman-like style of the bust.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Julius Caesar [no.1 and 2 plus 2 columns]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand procession or triumphant parade. The artwork features a scene filled with numerous figures and ornate elements. A group of figures carrying standards and flags are moving forward on the left side. The background shows detailed architecture resembling ancient Roman style. The right side of the image shows more figures participating in the parade, including soldiers, mounted individuals on horseback, and decorative chariots. The sky features dangling symbols of victory. The scene includes columns with elaborate carvings. The drawing is created in a meticulous style with fine line work and shading, adding to the historical or mythical quality.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Julius Caesar [no.3 and 4 plus 2 columns]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession with figures carrying various ornate objects. The scene features individuals carrying shields, urns, and musical instruments in great detail. Large urns and shields are being carried in a structured manner, while columns with intricate carvings frame the composition. The background shows a hilly landscape with classical architecture. Each figure is detailed with flowing garments and expressive postures, reflecting a grand and festive atmosphere similar to classical Roman triumphs.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Julius Caesar [no.5 and 6 plus 2 columns]
artworks.description: This is an image depicting a procession. It shows various figures and animals in elaborate detail, including elephants, horses, and objects being carried and displayed. The animals are ornately decorated, with elephants wearing decorative blankets and figures leading and riding them. The scene includes decorative elements like vases and garlands, suggesting a celebratory or victorious event. The background features architectural elements like a tower and an archway. The composition is framed with intricate columns adorned with various motifs, adding to the image's ceremonial atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Julius Caesar [no.7 and 8 plus 2 columns]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession or ceremony with detailed figures in two sections. On the left, people are depicted in classical garments, along with children and pets. Above them is a building with a barred window. On the right, uniformed individuals play musical instruments, carry standards, and possibly march. Decorative columns with mythical and floral motifs separate the two groups. The drawing emphasizes facial expressions and interactions, showcasing the dynamics of the scene.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Julius Caesar [no.9 plus 2 columns]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a triumphal procession scene with classical and mythological elements. The composition includes a chariot pulled by horses, various figures, and intricate architectural elements. The central figure in the chariot is adorned in classical garb, holding a palm branch, while other figures accompany or surround the chariot. The border on the left and the background feature motifs typical of classical antiquity, including ornate friezes and sculptural decorations. The work uses a monochromatic palette, giving it an antique and finely detailed appearance. The execution suggests an influence from Renaissance or neoclassical styles.

artworks.title: Descent into Limbo
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper (by Gian Marco Cavalli?)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an archway with various figures. The drawing depicts a composition, featuring a large archway carved into a rocky cliff facade. In the foreground, a central robed figure steps over a fallen door or platform. Surrounding this figure are other nude figures in various poses. Above the arch, two fantastical, winged creatures play trumpets. On the right, another creature with a serpent-like tail and leafy appendages observes the scene from atop the rocky surface. The composition showcases a play of light and shadow with intricate line work, detail, texture, and expression.

artworks.title: Flagellation of Christ, with the Pavement
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper (by Gian Marco Cavalli?)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 39.9 x 31 cm (15 11/16 x 12 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring ancient soldiers and warriors in a classical setting. The image shows armed men in armor typical of ancient Roman soldiers. The scene includes architectural elements like columns and a gridded floor. One man is pulling on a rope, while others surround a central figure. The figures are depicted with precise lines, showing structure and movement. Cross-hatching is used for light and shadow to highlight musculature and clothing folds. The drawing conveys a sense of historical importance, possibly related to conflict, mythology, or history.

artworks.title: Four Dancing Muses
artworks.description: Four women are depicted, standing in elegant poses. Their outfits are flowing and they have intricate hairstyles. They appear to be moving gracefully, with subtle fabric details around them.

artworks.title: The Entombment with Three Birds
artworks.artist: Giovanni Antonio da Brescia, after Andrea Mantegna
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rocky landscape where a group of individuals appear to be involved in an activity around a carved rock chamber or cave. The foreground shows a detailed depiction of a rugged terrain with jagged rock formations and sparse vegetation, including a couple of slender trees that rise between the rocks. The central focus is on a scene surrounding the rock chamber, which is open and appears to be of significance. The background features a series of crosses and an expansive sky scattered with clouds and birds. The style of the drawing is meticulous, capturing the textures of the rocky environment and the somber tone of the gathering.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Caesar: Soldiers Carrying Trophies
artworks.description: The image shows a group of soldiers with elaborate armor and ceremonial objects. The soldiers are carrying ornate armaments and ceremonial artifacts. The armor, helmets, and spears have detailed engravings and classical antiquity influences. The drawing conveys movement and historical grandeur through precise linework.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 24.1 x 20.5 cm (9 1/2 x 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a baby from the waist up. The woman is seated and gently holding the baby against her chest. Her facial expression is serene with closed eyes. She is wearing robes and her hair is covered. The baby appears relaxed in her arms, with curly hair and a round face. The background is a simple textured area.

artworks.title: Bacchanal with Silenus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of mythological or allegorical figures in a wooded setting. The image features several nude male figures, some of whom appear to be engaging in lively interaction. They are depicted with muscular and exaggerated physiques. In the background, there is detailed foliage, suggesting a rustic or forest environment. One figure is playing a wind instrument. The scene conveys a sense of dynamic energy and classical antiquity through its intricate line work and composition.

artworks.title: Oliver Goldsmith
artworks.artist: Giuseppi Filippo Liberati Marchi after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image displays an upper body portrait of a man in profile view facing left with his head slightly downward. He has distinct facial features, a high forehead, receding hairline, and styled hair with slight waves. He wears a garment with a fur-trimmed cloak over his shoulders, revealing a white shirt with a lace-trimmed collar and cuffs. The man holds a small closed book close to his chest with both hands. The background is plain and dark, highlighting the figure in the foreground without visible objects or scenery.

artworks.title: Before Caiaphas
artworks.description: The image shows four people in various positions. The central figure is standing with hands crossed, wearing a brown robe and a halo around their head. To the left is another standing figure wearing a blue hat and a red garment. A third person in a green outfit appears animated. On the right, a seated person is wearing a red robe and a tall red and blue hat, holding onto their robe. In the background are simple linear patterns and blocks of color suggesting an interior setting.

artworks.title: Guillaume de Brisacier
artworks.description: This image is a portrait of a man with long, wavy hair and a subtle mustache. He is wearing period clothing with a decorative collar. The portrait is encased within an oval frame with an ornate crest and laurel branches below it. The background features fine lines.

artworks.title: Henri de Lorraine
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, facing slightly left and looking directly at the viewer. He has refined facial features with a mustache and beard. His shoulder-length hair is curly. The man wears ornate clothing with a jacket and lace collar. He holds a rolled parchment in his right hand and rests his left hand on a table with ornate armor pieces. A plumed helmet and ornate sword are by his side. The background shows a stone ledge with foliage and a landscape with clouds and hills. There is a French inscription at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Two Men in Armour
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-body figures of knights in armor. The knight on the left has a helmet with a plume, a determined expression, and holds a spear in their left hand. The knight on the right is shown from the back, wearing a closed helmet, holding a polearm with their right hand, and their left hand on their hip. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral landscape. The composition includes intricate details showing trees, foliage, and architectural elements like a rustic cottage or barn. There is movement and texture created by detailed cross-hatching and line work. In the central area, there are large figures in robes or similar attire, indicating a gathering or meeting in nature. The style resembles an old master technique, possibly akin to early European engravings or Renaissance-era sketches, with a sepia-tone for an aged, classical look.
